summary_en: Annual dividend raised to ¥51.00/share from ¥46.00/share (¥5.00 increase, 10.9% hike) for FY10/26, on upward earnings revision. Comprises ¥45.00 ordinary dividend and ¥6.00 commemorative dividend. Target payout ratio approximately 30%.
title_en: Notice of Earnings Forecast Revision (Upward Revision) and Dividend Forecast Revision (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
FIT EASY announced on 12 June 2026 an upward revision to its full-year earnings forecast for the period ended 31 October 2026 and a corresponding increase to its dividend forecast. The revised earnings estimate raises net income to ¥2,473 million and earnings per share to ¥148.58, versus prior guidance of ¥2,150 million and ¥130.14 respectively—a 15.0% increase. The company attributes stronger-than-expected performance to increased membership in existing stores driven by unified promotional campaigns and planned introduction of new amusement services, combined with improved cost efficiency in selling, general and administrative expenses through organizational restructuring and improved cost-effectiveness in advertising and system-related spending.

In response, the company raises its full-year dividend forecast to ¥51.00 per share from ¥46.00, an increase of ¥5.00 (10.9%). The revised annual dividend comprises ¥45.00 in ordinary dividend and ¥6.00 in commemorative dividend. The company states it targets a payout ratio of approximately 30% as its fundamental dividend policy, with the aim of delivering stable distributions linked to earnings performance.
